text: Objective: Through some courses study, students could master Chinese teaching skills and have the basic ability of being a Chinese-language teacher. Courses: Chinese Erros Analysis, Teacher's Classroom Language, Chinese Teaching Skills, Chinese Grammar Teaching, Chinese Vocabulary Teaching, Chinese Listening Teaching, Oral Chinese Teaching, Chinese Reading Teaching, Chinese Teaching and Test etc. Notes: The program will open if the number of applicants are over 10 or above. It could accept group and individual registration. Group class could decide the study content and study time.
